mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.phone_enc, c.preferred_language AS language, c.status, c.registered_at, c.last_visit_at, coalesce(a.current_stamps, 0) AS current_stamps, coalesce(a.total_stamps, 0) AS total_stamps, coalesce(a.rewards_earned, 0) AS rewards_earned, coalesce(a.rewards_redeemed, 0) AS rewards_redeemed, (SELECT count(*) FROM fraud_flags f WHERE f.customer_id = c.id AND f.resolved_at IS NULL) AS open_fraud_flags FROM customers c LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND s.branch_id IN #{branchId})

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.id, 'STAMP' AS kind, s.status, s.source, s.branch_id, coalesce(s.revoke_reason, s.reason) AS reason, NULL::text AS reward_name, s.created_at AS at, NULL::timestamptz AS redeemed_at FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = #{customerId} UNION ALL SELECT r.id, 'REWARD', r.status, NULL, r.redeemed_branch_id, NULL, r.reward_name_snapshot::text, r.earned_at, r.redeemed_at FROM rewards r WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ) t ORDER BY t.at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM rewards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId})
